request.description: Create a category with optional child services. Set category isActive to false to create it inactive; omit it or use true to create it active. Each child service can also have its own isActive value.

Update any supplied category fields. Set isActive to true to activate or false to deactivate. In services, entries with id are updated and entries without id are created; their isActive field works the same way. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
Returns active service categories only, without nested services; no authentication required.
Returns only active services under the category. The data value is an empty array when no active services are found.
